comments.content: The IPv4 constructor `new IPAddress(long)` interprets the argument as a full 4-byte address in network byte order. `_sockaddr.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr` is a uint; passing it to the `long` overload is fine since it's already in network byte order. However, verify the value isn't sign-extended or truncated—prefer the explicit `new IPAddress(uint)`/byte-based construction to avoid ambiguity. Confirm this produces the same result as the previous byte-copy implementation.
